style.promptPrefix: TO BE LOCKED: choose one prefix and seed before generating any frame, then never change them — style consistency across the set depends on it. Suggested register: pale violet-grey daylight, long shadows falling in two directions at once, edges of objects very slightly doubled. Architectural clarity; the wrongness is always in the light, never in the drawing.
style.note: Frames are generated offline and hand-curated (ROADMAP Phase 2). Drop finished PNGs into apps/web/public/art/<slot>.png — BeatArt falls back png → svg → gradient, so partial sets are playable.

slots.brief: A plain room at morning, ordinary in every respect. A bare forearm in the foreground bearing a fresh geometric mark. The light comes from two windows that cast shadows at different angles.
A civic registry: ledgers open across a long table, one line in each scraped clean of a name, the surrounding text closed neatly over the gap.
A figure standing still while fragments of unrelated scenes overlay them — a battle, a hand, a doorway — none of them agreeing on light direction.
A bright formal court where every courtier is mid-gesture toward something that has not happened. Sundials on every surface, all reading slightly ahead.
A colossal archive of stacked record-cases lit by low amber lamps, one very old archivist on a ladder, dust suspended and unmoving.
A crowded market under a torn violet sky, stalls selling small stoppered containers that hold weather, afternoons, and voices.
A blasted corridor of land where rain falls upward in patches and a supply column burns without being consumed. A mile-marker stone at centre.
A small disciplined camp in the Scar. Tents in exact rows. At the centre, on a plain table, a closed hatbox that everything is arranged around.
The hatbox open a crack, and inside it a whole landscape at the wrong scale — a continent folded into sixty minutes, still running.
A threshold standing free in open ground, and through it a completely ordinary sunlit month — roads, weather, a sky — going on without anyone.
Figures approaching across a field who are the same figures as the viewer's party, older, worn, and entirely certain.
A man in unremarkable state dress in an empty hall, seen clearly, whose reflection in the floor is missing. He is not posing; he is waiting.
A visible seam in the air across an open landscape, edges of reality on either side not quite matching. Nothing dramatic. Just an unclosed cut.
A city square in the middle of a normal afternoon where every single person has stopped walking at the same instant.
A serene state portrait of an unremarkable elderly ruler who reigned forty years and died in bed. Nothing in the frame is wrong at all.
A blank first page in a new archive register, quill beside it, the title line written and the rest empty.
